brief:
Jeremy Corbyn and U.S. Representative Rashida Tlaib have joined dozens of politicians and legal organizations in condemning the prosecution of pro-Palestine activists known as the Ulm 5, Middle East Eye reported. The case has drawn international concern over the treatment of the defendants and the charges they face.

The coalition of politicians and legal groups has raised alarm over both the prosecution itself and the conditions under which the activists are being held, signaling broader concern about the handling of pro-Palestine activism in the jurisdiction where charges have been brought.
dek: Jeremy Corbyn and Rashida Tlaib join politicians and legal groups condemning Ulm 5 prosecution Jeremy Corbyn and Rashida Tlaib are among dozens of politicians and legal organisations raising alarm over the prosecution and treatment of pro- Palestine activists…
title: Corbyn, Tlaib condemn prosecution of pro-Palestine activists in Ulm
